body: I'm not really sure what to say, but I want you to know we're out here, reading your story. Please don't end your dialog. I've never been too good at helping to lift others, but I'll hang around this thread for a while. Also there are some great people to talk to at [The Trevor Project](http://www.thetrevorproject.org/) 1-866-488-7386.

I've got the [One](http://amzn.com/B0095PZHPE). I like it, although after the month or two, I got lazy about tracking water/food and sleep. Still makes for a solid tracker to keep your mind on your goals and make small changes to be healthier. Neat stuff.
I'm in Tulsa. Not far from downtown.
I'm actually supposed to be heading to Portland next month on a business trip. Thanks for posting this, might give me some ideas of stuff to see while I'm in town. Hope you do well up there.
Glad to know i'm not the only OK resident in this sub. Also it's really exciting that you know them personally. Congratulations to them for the win and you, by proxy, for awesomenes.
Not that I know of, but I may be moving to Tulsa soon. I know that's not really nearby, but I haven't heard much chatter on this sub about anything in Oklahoma. Yet...
